metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented a full Rust Cargo CLI project in `output/`:

- Manifest: [Cargo.toml](/workspace/output/Cargo.toml)
- Binary entry point: [main.rs](/workspace/output/src/main.rs)

What’s implemented:

- CLI flags:
  - `--bib`, `--style`, `--cites`, `--aux`, `--output`, optional `--log`
  - `--cites` and `--aux` are concatenated in order then deduplicated (case-insensitive keys)
- `.bib` parser:
  - regular entries, `@string`, `@preamble`, `@comment`
  - `{}` / `()` entry delimiters
  - `#` concatenation, numeric/string/macro operands
  - predefined month macros + override behavior
  - duplicate-key warning
  - unresolved-macro warning
- Citation resolution:
  - case-insensitive cite lookup
  - missing cited keys tracked in log
- `crossref` handling:
  - direct (non-transitive) inheritance
  - unresolved-crossref and two-entry cycle warnings
- `.bst` parser and interpreter:
  - top-level commands (`ENTRY`, `STRINGS`, `INTEGERS`, `FUNCTION`, `MACRO`, `READ`, `EXECUTE`, `ITERATE`, `REVERSE`, `SORT`)
  - stack machine values: int/string/function/missing
  - built-ins required by canonical styles, including name formatting, case/text ops, sorting, output ops, and control flow
  - load-time undefined-function checks (quoted undefined => warning; hard undefined call => error)
- Output behavior:
  - `.bbl` produced from `write$`/`newline$`
  - LF line endings
  - 79-column wrapping with backward scan + forward fallback and continuation indent
  - end-of-run flush of pending output
- Error contract:
  - exit `0` success, `1` parse/runtime/arg failures
  - on failure, `--output` gets structured error JSON (`source`, `line`, `column`, `message`) plus warning array
- Optional structured log JSON always written when `--log` is provided, including required counters and warning chronology.

Validation done:

- `cargo build --release --manifest-path /workspace/output/Cargo.toml` succeeds.
- End-to-end smoke runs against canonical style files (`plain.bst`, `unsrt.bst`, `alpha.bst`) comp
